phase_name: Extract the freshness comparison into a shared library

objectives.description: Create deploy-freshness-lib.sh with two exported functions
Re-point check-deploy-freshness.sh at the library, byte-identical output
Extend test-deploy-freshness.sh for the library's two functions

deviations.description: Re-point check-deploy-freshness.sh at the library using the same deploy-tree-first / source-store-fallback candidate-resolution pattern update-task-status.sh already uses for phase-heading-patterns.sh
deviations.reason: check-deploy-freshness.sh has no PROJECT_ROOT concept (no deploy-root-guard.sh, deliberately standalone/preflight-cheap) and its $1 REPO_ROOT argument names the CONSUMER repo being checked, not this script's own location -- a PROJECT_ROOT-anchored candidate list would be wrong here. Used SCRIPT_DIR-relative sibling lookup (lib/deploy-freshness-lib.sh next to the script) instead, which resolves correctly in both the deployed tree and the source store with no root computation needed, and updated test-deploy-freshness.sh's fixture to copy the library alongside the checker so the sibling relationship holds inside the fixture too.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered — SCRIPT_DIR-relative sibling lookup instead of PROJECT_ROOT-anchored candidates; see phase-2-progress.json)*
